# Synthetic fixture (INF04-01): billable components declared but referenced by nothing in the template.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Conditions:
  CreateSpare: !Equals [!Ref "AWS::Region", ap-south-1]
Resources:
  OrphanEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  IdleNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: subnet-0123456789abcdef0
      AllocationId: eipalloc-0123456789abcdef0
  PublicAlb:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Subnets: [subnet-0123456789abcdef0, subnet-0fedcba9876543210]
  NamedNlb:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: shared-nlb
      Type: network
      Subnets: [subnet-0123456789abcdef0]
  DataVolume:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Volume
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: ap-south-1a
      Size: 100
  SpareEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateSpare
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
